description: This file provides functions for generating translation prompts based on language, with specific templates for Chinese, Japanese, and a generic fallback. It includes functions for formatting prompts, processing glossaries, and language label normalization.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a language code, defaulting to the input if unrecognized.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a translation prompt string based on source and target languages, utilizing specific templates for Chinese and Japanese or a generic template for others.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Generates a formatted string listing glossary entries, to be incorporated into translation prompts.
